finalText:
Done. Summary:

- Checked R2087: Dana Whitfield, economy cabin, originally on AA210 (dep 17:40, $310.00 fare).
- Searched SFO→ORD on 2026-08-03 in economy: UA88 (06:15) had 0 seats left; AA918 (07:30) is cancelled; the earliest scheduled flight with an available economy seat was **AA204, departing 09:05** (4 seats left, fare $390.00).
- Confirmed Dana's tier is **Gold**, which is exempt from the $75 change fee per economy fare rules — so no change fee was charged.
- Moved reservation R2087 segment 0 from AA210 to AA204, keeping the same economy cabin (no cabin change).
- Charged the fare difference of $80.00 ($390.00 − $310.00), since fare differences apply to all tiers regardless of exemption status.

Dana Whitfield is now booked on AA204 (SFO→ORD, 2026-08-03, 09:05, economy), and $80.00 has been charged to R2087 for the fare difference. No change fee was applied due to her Gold status.
